source.description: Name of the publisher, for example Reuters.

publishedAt.description: When the article was published (ISO date and time, UTC).

url.description: Link to the article on the publisher's site; null when URL resolving is off or the link could not be resolved.

googleNewsUrl.description: Link to the article on Google News.

articleId.description: ID of the article on Google News; the same article keeps the same ID across runs.

position.description: Position of the article in its feed, from 1.

query.description: Search query that found the article; null for topic and top-stories feeds.

topic.description: Google News topic of the feed, for example BUSINESS, or TOP_STORIES; null for searches.

dateWindow.description: Dates of the search as {after, before} (YYYY-MM-DD), when the input sets dates; null otherwise.

edition.description: Google News edition (country and language), for example US:en.

relatedArticles.description: Other coverage of the same story that Google News groups with the article: title, source and link.
